售票员: At nineteen minutes past eight.

Lesson 95

乘务员: Tickets, please.

George: We want to catch the eight nineteen to London.

乘务员: You’ve just missed it!

George: What! It’s only eight fifteen.

乘务员: I’m sorry, sir. That clock’s ten minutes slow.
